locator: Section 1, unnumbered theorem, p.83 (original Russian edition)
scope: For any congruence subgroup C of PSL2(Z), the divisor class of the difference of two cusps on the compactified modular curve has finite order. Full statement and proof read on the actual p.83 image. The receiving modular parametrization induces a homomorphism from the Jacobian, hence sends each cusp difference to torsion. The source explicitly calls this a generalization of Manin Corollary3.6. No statement about a bare absolute cusp image without chosen base cusp is inferred.
